**This document analyzes RUNX1 (HD & FPD) in the HSC population, using data downloaded from Phs003508.v1.p1**

---

# **PART 1 - Required Packages**

First, check the Seurat version to ensure that you begin the analysis using a version < 5.0, as this is a requirement 
of one of the steps. Please consult the README.txt file for more details.

# **PART 2 - Loading Dataset**

## HD (Control)

```{r hdcontrol, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
wt_dir <- here("counts", "HD")

main_dirs <- list.dirs(wt_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
# Loop through each main directory
for (main_dir in main_dirs) {
  # Get the subdirectories inside each main directory
  sub_dirs <- list.dirs(main_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  
  # Loop through each subdirectory
  for (sub_dir in sub_dirs) {
    h5_file <- file.path(sub_dir, "outs", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
    
    if (file.exists(h5_file)) {
      data <- Read10X_h5(h5_file, use.names = TRUE)
      project_name <- gsub("_counts", "", basename(sub_dir))
      project <- basename(main_dir)  
      seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(data, project = project)
      seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, project_name, col.name = "Sample")
      seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, "HD", col.name = "Condition")
      assign(project_name, seurat_obj, envir = .GlobalEnv) 
    }
  }
}

# Merge
cell_ids <- paste0("HD", c(1:6))
obj <- ls(pattern = "^SRR")
obj_list <- mget(obj)
hd <- merge(x = obj_list[[1]], y = obj_list[2:length(obj_list)], add.cell.ids = cell_ids)
ncol(hd)
hd <- JoinLayers (hd)

rm(list=obj)

# Adding Metadata

## Gender
hd@meta.data$Gender <- "Male"
hd@meta.data[substr(hd@meta.data$orig.ident, 6,7) %in% "05","Gender"] <- "Female"
hd <- AddMetaData(hd, hd@meta.data$Gender, col.name = "Gender")

## Mitochondria
a <- rownames(hd)[grep("^MT-",rownames(hd))]
b <- GetAssayData(object = hd, layer = "counts")
mit <- colSums(b[a,])/Matrix::colSums(b)*100
hd <- AddMetaData(hd, mit, col.name = "Mitoc")

## Ribosomal
a <- rownames(hd)[grep("^RPS|^RPL",rownames(hd))]
b <- GetAssayData(object = hd, layer = "counts")
c <- colSums(b[a,])/Matrix::colSums(b)*100
hd <- AddMetaData(hd, c, col.name = "percent.ribo")

## Complexity
a <- log10(hd@meta.data$nFeature_RNA)/log10(hd@meta.data$nCount_RNA)
hd <- AddMetaData(hd, a, col.name = "Complexity")
```

## FPD

```{r fpd, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
fpd_dir <- here("counts", "FPD")

main_dirs <- list.dirs(fpd_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
# Loop through each main directory
for (main_dir in main_dirs) {
  # Get the subdirectories inside each main directory
  sub_dirs <- list.dirs(main_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  
  # Loop through each subdirectory
  for (sub_dir in sub_dirs) {
    h5_file <- file.path(sub_dir, "outs", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
    
    if (file.exists(h5_file)) {
      data <- Read10X_h5(h5_file, use.names = TRUE)
      project_name <- gsub("_counts", "", basename(sub_dir))
      project <- basename(main_dir)  
      seurat_obj <- CreateSeuratObject(data, project = project)
      seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, project_name, col.name = "Sample")
      seurat_obj <- AddMetaData(seurat_obj, "FPD", col.name = "Condition")
      assign(project_name, seurat_obj, envir = .GlobalEnv) 
    }
  }
}

# Merge
cell_ids <- paste0("FPD", c(1:24))
obj <- ls(pattern = "^SRR")
obj_list <- mget(obj)
fpd <- merge(x = obj_list[[1]], y = obj_list[2:length(obj_list)], add.cell.ids = cell_ids)
ncol(fpd) 
fpd <- JoinLayers (fpd)

rm(list=obj)

# Adding Metadata

## Gender
fpd@meta.data$Gender <- "Male"
fpd@meta.data[fpd@meta.data$orig.ident %in% c("FPD10","FPD12","FPD3","FPD4","FPD6","FPD8"),"Gender"] <- "Female"
fpd <- AddMetaData(fpd, fpd@meta.data$Gender, col.name = "Gender")

## Mitochondria
a <- rownames(fpd)[grep("^MT-",rownames(fpd))]
b <- GetAssayData(object = fpd, layer = "counts")
mit <- colSums(b[a,])/Matrix::colSums(b)*100
fpd <- AddMetaData(fpd, mit, col.name = "Mitoc")

## Ribosomal
a <- rownames(fpd)[grep("^RPS|^RPL",rownames(fpd))]
b <- GetAssayData(object = fpd, layer = "counts")
c <- colSums(b[a,])/Matrix::colSums(b)*100
fpd <- AddMetaData(fpd, c, col.name = "percent.ribo")

## Complexity
a <- log10(fpd@meta.data$nFeature_RNA)/log10(fpd@meta.data$nCount_RNA)
fpd <- AddMetaData(fpd, a, col.name = "Complexity")
```

# **PART 3 - Quality Control**

## Mitochondria

```{r mitoqc, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# HD
hd_mito <- as.data.frame(hd@meta.data) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Condition, Mitoc, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 1, width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("deeppink","cyan3")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(2, 5.8), linetype='dashed', color=c('blue', 'red'), size=0.2)+
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

# FPD
fpd_mito <- as.data.frame(fpd@meta.data) %>%
  ggplot(aes(Condition, Mitoc, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 1, width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("deeppink","cyan3")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(1.8, 6.5), linetype='dashed', color=c('blue', 'red'), size=0.2)+
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        axis.title.x = element_blank())

p <- hd_mito + fpd_mito

p
```

## Complexity

```{r complexqc, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# HD
comp_hd <- as.data.frame(hd@meta.data) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color=Gender, x=Complexity, fill=Condition)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("blue")) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8)

# FPD
comp_fpd <- as.data.frame(fpd@meta.data) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color=Gender, x=Complexity, fill=Condition)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("red")) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8)

p <- comp_hd + comp_fpd

p
```

```{r nfeatqc, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
  ggplot(aes(Condition, nFeature_RNA, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = 1, width = 0.8) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("deeppink","cyan3")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(200,5500), linetype='dashed',
```


# **PART 4 - Filtering Cells**

```{r filtering, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# HD
hd$log10GenesPerUMI <- log10(hd$nFeature_RNA) / log10(hd$nCount_RNA)
hd$mitoRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(object = hd, pattern = "^MT-")
hd$mitoRatio <- hd@meta.data$mitoRatio / 100
hd$riboRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(object = hd, pattern = "^RPS|^RPL")
hd$riboRatio <- hd@meta.data$riboRatio / 100
a <- hd@meta.data
a$cells <- rownames(a)
a <- a %>%
  dplyr::rename(seq_folder = orig.ident,
                nUMI = nCount_RNA,
                nGene = nFeature_RNA)
hd@meta.data <- a

meta <- hd@meta.data

# Visualize the number of cell counts per sample
meta %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Sample, fill=Sample)) + 
  geom_bar() +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept=c(13000), linetype='dashed', 
             color=c("blue"), size=0.2) +
  ggtitle("NCells") 

# Visualize the number UMIs/transcripts per cell
meta %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color=Sample, x=nUMI, fill= Sample)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  theme_classic() +
  ylab("Cell density") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 500)

# Visualize the distribution of genes detected per cell via histogram
meta %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color=Sample, x=nGene, fill= Sample)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  theme_classic() +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 350)

#Visualize the distribution of genes detected per cell via boxplot
meta %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=Sample, y=log10(nGene), fill=Sample)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust=1)) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold")) +
  ggtitle("NCells vs NGenes")

# Visualize the correlation between genes detected and number of UMIs 
meta %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=nUMI, y=nGene, color=mitoRatio)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "gray90", high = "black") +
  stat_smooth(method=lm) +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  scale_y_log10() + 
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 800) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 500) +
  facet_wrap(~Sample)

# Visualize the distribution of mitochondrial gene expression detected per cell
meta %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color=Sample, x=mitoRatio, fill=Sample)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.08)

meta %>%
  ggplot(aes(mitoRatio)) + 
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill="yellow", colour="black") +
  ggtitle("Distribution of Percentage Mitochondria") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 10)

# Visualize the distribution of ribosomal gene expression detected per cell
meta %>% 
  ggplot(aes(color=Sample, x=riboRatio, fill=Sample)) + 
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_x_log10() + 
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.06)

# Visualize the overall complexity of the gene expression by visualizing the genes detected per UMI
meta %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=log10GenesPerUMI, color = Sample, fill=Sample)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.2) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0.8)

# Filtering HD cells
hd_filt <- subset(x = hd, 
                   subset= (nUMI >= 200 & nUMI <= 21000) & 
                     (nGene >= 200 & nGene <= 6250) & 
                     (riboRatio >= 0.06) &
                     (log10GenesPerUMI > 0.80) & 
                     (Mitoc < 5.8))

ncol(hd) 
ncol(hd_filt) 

# FPD

fpd$mitoRatio <- PercentageFeatureSet(object = fpd, pattern = "^MT-")
```

# **PART 5 -  Data Scale & Normalization**

```{r scale&norm, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
hd <- hd_filt
fpd <- fpd_filt
rm(hd_filt, fpd_filt)
gc()

# HD
hd <- RunAzimuth(hd , reference = "bonemarrowref")
obj <- NormalizeData(object = hd)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(object = obj)
genes <- rownames(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(object = obj, features=genes)
obj <- RunPCA(object = obj, features = VariableFeatures(object = obj))
ElbowPlot(obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
obj <- FindNeighbors(object = obj, dims = 1:20)
obj <- FindClusters(object = obj, resolution=0.8, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(object = obj, dims= 1:20, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2")

## Harmony
Idents(obj) <- "unintegrated_clusters"

obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$Sample)

obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = obj, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony"
)

obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 0.8, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2")

p <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()

ggsave("plots/UMAP_Harmony_HD.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)

hd_obj <- obj
rm(obj)

# FPD
fpd <- RunAzimuth(fpd , reference = "bonemarrowref")
obj <- NormalizeData(object = fpd)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(object = obj)
genes <- rownames(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(object = obj, features=genes)
obj <- RunPCA(object = obj, features = VariableFeatures(object = obj))
ElbowPlot(obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
obj <- FindNeighbors(object = obj, dims = 1:20)
obj <- FindClusters(object = obj, resolution=1, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(object = obj, dims= 1:20, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2")

## Harmony
Idents(obj) <- "unintegrated_clusters"

obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$Sample)

obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = obj, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony"
)

obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:20, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "predicted.celltype.l2")

p <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()

ggsave("plots/UMAP_Harmony_FPD.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)

fpd_obj <- obj
rm(obj)
```

# **PART 6 - Merging Seurats**

```{r merging, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
obj <- merge(hd, c(fpd))
rm(hd,fpd)

obj <- JoinLayers(obj, assay = "RNA")
obj <- RunAzimuth(obj , reference = "bonemarrowref")

obj <- NormalizeData(object = obj)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(object = obj)
genes <- rownames(obj)
obj <- ScaleData(object = obj, features=genes)
obj <- RunPCA(object = obj, features = VariableFeatures(object = obj))
ElbowPlot(obj, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
obj <- FindNeighbors(object = obj, dims = 1:16)
obj <- FindClusters(object = obj, resolution=1, cluster.name = "unintegrated_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(object = obj, dims= 1:16, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()
DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = F, group.by = "Condition")

## Harmony
Idents(obj) <- "unintegrated_clusters"

obj[["RNA"]] <- split(obj[["RNA"]], f = obj$Sample)

obj <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = obj, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony"
)

obj <- FindNeighbors(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:16)
obj <- FindClusters(obj, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")
obj <- RunUMAP(obj, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:16, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "Condition")

p <- DimPlot(obj, reduction = "umap.harmony", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()

ggsave("plots/UMAP_Harmony_merged.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)

colnames(obj@meta.data)[colnames(obj@meta.data) == "harmony_clusters"] <- "Clusters"
obj@meta.data$Clusters <- paste0("Cluster_",obj@meta.data$Clusters)

save(obj, file="rda/seurats_harmony.rda")
```

# **PART 8 - Identifying HSC Score**

Install HSCScore package following the tutorial:https://github.com/fionahamey/hscScore
Download the necessary files from here: https://zenodo.org/records/3332151

```{r hscscore, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
method <- "homologene"

species <- orthogene::map_species(species = c("human","mus musculus"), 
                                  output_format = "id")

orth <- orthogene::report_orthologs(target_species = "human",
                                    reference_species = "mouse",
                                    method_all_genes = method,
                                    method_convert_orthologs = method) 

x <- as.data.frame(orth)
x <- x[,c(4,5)]
colnames(x) <- c("Human","Mouse")
keep <- x$Human

seurat <- subset(obj, features = keep)
dim(seurat)

x <- x[x$Human %in% rownames(seurat),]

match_idx <- match(rownames(seurat), x$Human)

rownames(seurat) <- ifelse(
  !is.na(match_idx),
  x$Mouse[match_idx],
  rownames(seurat)  
)

seurat <- JoinLayers(seurat)

mat <- as.data.frame(seurat@assays$RNA$counts)

file_path <- "hscscore/model_molo_genes.txt"
genes <- scan(file_path, what = "character", sep = "\n")

a <- mat[rownames(mat) %in% genes,]

missing <- setdiff(genes, rownames(a))

num_new_rows <- 8

new_rows <- data.frame(matrix(0, nrow=num_new_rows, ncol=ncol(a)))
colnames(new_rows) <- colnames(a)

df <- rbind(a, new_rows)

rownames(df)[(nrow(df)-num_new_rows+1):nrow(df)] <- c("2810417H13Rik", "Cdkn1c", "Fam64a", "Ifitm1","Ly6a","Sgol1","Sqrdl","Sult1a1")

write.table(df, file = "hscscore/all.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = TRUE, quote = FALSE)

# Assigning HSCs
cells <- colnames(mat)

score <- read.csv("hscScore/score.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ",")
rownames(score) <- cells
max(score$HSC_Score)
min(score$HSC_Score)

score$Type <- "Unknown"
score[score$HSC_Score >= 0.3, "Type"] <- "HSC"
table(score$Type)

score$Level <- "Absent"
score[(score$HSC_Score >= 0.35 & score$Type != "Unknown"), "Level"] <- "HSC_High"
score[(score$HSC_Score < 0.35 & score$HSC_Score >= 0.25 & score$Type != "Unknown"), "Level"] <- "HSC_Medium"
score[(score$HSC_Score < 0.25 & score$Type != "Unknown"), "Level"] <- "HSC_Low"
table(score$Level)
score$cells <- rownames(score)

save(score, file="./hscScore/hsc_scores.rda")
```

After running HSCScore the output file "score.csv" will be generated. Load the score file into R to continue the analysis.
The annotation of cell types - LT-HSC; ST-HSC and MPPs - was performed in accordance with the HSCScore paper.

```{r score, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
meta <- obj@meta.data

meta <- merge(meta, score[,c("cells","Level","Type")], by.x="cells", by.y="cells")
rownames(meta) <- meta$cells
check <- meta[(meta$predicted.celltype.l2 == "HSC" & meta$Type == "HSC"),]

x <- meta %>%
  group_by(Type, Level, predicted.celltype.l2, Clusters) %>%
  summarize(Total = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Total))

x <- x[x$Type == "HSC" & x$predicted.celltype.l2 == "HSC",]

a <- x %>%
  group_by(Clusters) %>%
  summarize(ClusterTotal = sum(Total), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(ClusterTotal))

meta$Score <- meta$predicted.celltype.l2
meta$prediction <- meta$Score
meta[meta$Clusters %in% c("Cluster_7"),"prediction"] <- "HSC"

meta$Trust <- "No"
meta[(meta$Level %in% c("HSC_Medium","HSC_High") & meta$predicted.celltype.l2 == "HSC"), "Trust"] <- "HSC"
meta$azim <- "No"
meta[meta$predicted.celltype.l2 == "HSC", "azim"] <- "HSC"

obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$prediction, col.name = "Prediction")
obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$Level, col.name = "Level")
obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$Trust, col.name = "Trust")
obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$azim, col.name = "azim")

meta <- obj@meta.data

# HSC Plot Density
umap_coords <- as.data.frame(Embeddings(obj, "umap.harmony"))
umap_coords$cell <- rownames(umap_coords)
all_coords <- merge(umap_coords, obj@meta.data, by.x = "cell", by.y="cells")
highlighted_coords <- all_coords[(all_coords$Clusters == "Cluster_7" & all_coords$Trust == "HSC"), ]

scale.col <- cet_pal(10, name = "fire")
custom_colors <- c("white",  "black", scale.col)

p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = all_coords, aes(x = umapharmony_1, y = umapharmony_2), 
             color = "grey", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_density_2d_filled(data = highlighted_coords, 
                         aes(x = umapharmony_1, y = umapharmony_2, 
                             fill = as.numeric(after_stat(level))), 
                         alpha = 0.75, n = 150, h = c(1.2, 1.2), color = NA) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = custom_colors) +
  labs(fill = "HSC Density") +
  theme_classic() +
  ggtitle("HSC cells")

ggsave("plots/UMAP_HSCscore_Density.png", p, height=5.5, width=6.8, dpi=300)
```

# **PART 9 - scTE Data**

scTE is a Python package developed to quantify the expression of transposable elements (TEs) in single-cell sequencing data.
Both the tutorial and the README.txt can be found here: https://github.com/JiekaiLab/scTE

**IMPORTANT: This step requires Seurat and SeuratObject to be downgraded to version < 5.0**

## HD (Control)

```{r scTE-Control, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
wt_dir <- here("counts", "HD")

main_dirs <- list.dirs(wt_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

# Loop through each main directory
for (main_dir in main_dirs) {
  # Get the subdirectories inside each main directory
  sub_dirs <- list.dirs(main_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)
  
  # Loop through each subdirectory
  for (sub_dir in sub_dirs) {
    
    input_file <- file.path(sub_dir, "outs/filtered", "out.h5ad")
    
    if (file.exists(input_file)) {
      h5_file <- Convert(input_file, dest = "h5seurat", overwrite = FALSE)
      project <- basename(main_dir) 
      data <- LoadH5Seurat(h5_file)
      data@project.name <- project
      project_name <- gsub("_counts", "", basename(sub_dir))
      data <- AddMetaData(data, project_name, col.name = "Sample")
      data <- AddMetaData(data, "HD", col.name = "Condition")
      assign(project_name, data, envir = .GlobalEnv)  
    }
  }
}

# Merge
cell_ids <- paste0("HD", c(1:6))
save <- ls(pattern = "^SRR")
obj_list <- mget(save)
hd <- merge(x = obj_list[[1]], y = obj_list[2:length(obj_list)], add.cell.ids = cell_ids)
ncol(hd)

rm(list=save)
```

## FPD

```{r scTE-FPD, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
fpd_dir <- here("counts", "FPD")

main_dirs <- list.dirs(fpd_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

# Loop through each main directory
for (main_dir in main_dirs) {

  for (sub_dir in sub_dirs) {
    
    input_file <- file.path(sub_dir, "outs/filtered", "out.h5ad")
    
    if (file.exists(input_file)) {
      h5_file <- Convert(input_file, dest = "h5seurat", overwrite = FALSE)
      project <- basename(main_dir) 
      data <- LoadH5Seurat(h5_file)
      data@project.name <- project
      project_name <- gsub("_counts", "", basename(sub_dir))
      data <- AddMetaData(data, project_name, col.name = "Sample")
      data <- AddMetaData(data, "FPD", col.name = "Condition")
      assign(project_name, data, envir = .GlobalEnv)  
    }

}

# Merge
cell_ids <- paste0("FPD", c(1:24))
save <- ls(pattern = "^SRR")
obj_list <- mget(save)
fpd <- merge(x = obj_list[[1]], y = obj_list[2:length(obj_list)], add.cell.ids = cell_ids)
ncol(fpd)

rm(list=save)
```

## Merging Conditions

```{r scTE-merging, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# Scale & Normalize
hd <- NormalizeData(object = hd)
hd <- FindVariableFeatures(object = hd)
hd <- ScaleData(object = hd)

fpd <- NormalizeData(object = fpd)
fpd <- FindVariableFeatures(object = fpd)
fpd <- ScaleData(object = fpd)

merge <- merge(hd, c(fpd))
dim(merge) 
colnames(merge) <- paste0(colnames(merge), "-1")

save(merge, file="rda/merge_scTE.rda")
```

## Loading Gencode Files

This steps requires using reference files.

Download required files from: 
https://ftp.ebi.ac.uk/pub/databases/gencode/Gencode_human/release_48/gencode.v48.annotation.gtf.gz
https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg38/database/

### Genes 

```{r load-genes, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
gencode = "gencode/gencode.v48.annotation.gtf.gz"
gunzip(gencode)
gencode <- readGFF("gencode/gencode.v48.annotation.gtf")
colnames(gencode)
genes <- gencode[,c(1,3:5,7,9,10,11,15)]
colnames(genes)
names(genes) <- c("seqname","Gene.Type","start","end","strand",
                  "Gene.ID","Type","Gene.Name","Transc.Type")

genes <- genes[genes$Gene.Type %in% "gene",] 
genes <- genes[,-c(2,9)]

genes <- genes[grep("+_PAR_+",genes$Gene.ID,invert=T),]
aux <- strsplit(genes$Gene.ID, "\\." )
aux <- unlist(lapply(aux, "[[", 1 )) 
genes$Gene.ID <- aux
rownames(genes) <- aux 

save(gencode, genes, file="rda/gencodeV48.rda")
```

### Transposable Elements (TEs)

```{r load-tes, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
file_name = "gencode/rmsk.txt.gz"
gunzip(file_name)

TE <- read.table("gencode/rmsk.txt", header = FALSE, sep = "")
names(TE) <- c("bin","swScore","milliDiv","milliDel","millilns","seqnames",
               "start","end","Gene.Left","strand","TE.Name","TE.Class",
               "TE.Family","TE.start","TE.end","TE.Left","ID")

TEs <- TE[,c(6:8,10:15)]

save(TEs, file="rda/TEs.rda")
```

### Integrating Genes & TEs

```{r integration, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/gencodeV48.rda")
load("rda/TEs.rda")

x <- TEs
rm(TEs)

gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(x, keep.extra.columns=TRUE)
names <- mcols(gr)$TE.Name

gen.gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(genes, keep.extra.columns=TRUE)

overlap <- suppressWarnings(findOverlaps(gr,gen.gr,ignore.strand=T, 
                                         type="within"))
a <- as.data.frame(overlap)
a <- a[with(a,order(queryHits,subjectHits)),]

genes$has.TE <- FALSE
genes[(a$subjectHits),"has.TE"] <- TRUE
table(genes$has.TE) 

genes$te.id <- NA
aux <- gr[(a$subjectHits),]
length(aux)

genes[(a$subjectHits), "te.id"] <- mcols(aux)[,1]
keep <- genes[a$subjectHits,]

keep$unique<- paste(keep$Gene.Name, keep$te.id, sep = "_")
keep <- keep[!duplicated(keep$unique),] 

save(keep, file="rda/TEs_annotated.rda")
```

### Getting the Promoters

```{r promoters, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/gencodeV48.rda")
load("rda/TEs.rda")
load("rda/TEs_annotated.rda")

x <- TEs
rm(TEs)

promoter <- promoters(makeGRangesFromDataFrame(genes, TRUE))

gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(x, keep.extra.columns=TRUE)
names <- mcols(gr)$TE.Name

overlap <- suppressWarnings(findOverlaps(gr,promoter,ignore.strand=T, 
                                         type="within"))
a <- as.data.frame(overlap)
a <- a[with(a,order(queryHits,subjectHits)),]

genes$TE.promoters <- FALSE
genes[(a$subjectHits),"TE.promoters"] <- TRUE
table(genes$TE.promoters) 
genes$te.id <- NA
aux <- gr[(a$subjectHits),]
length(aux)
genes[(a$subjectHits), "te.id"] <- mcols(aux)[,1]
keep.promoters <- genes[a$subjectHits,]

keep.promoters$unique<- paste(keep.promoters$Gene.Name, keep.promoters$te.id,
                              sep = "_")
keep.promoters <- keep.promoters[!duplicated(keep.promoters$unique),] 

keep$in.promoter <- "FALSE"
keep[keep$Gene.Name %in% keep.promoters$Gene.Name, "in.promoter"] <- "TRUE"
table(keep$in.promoter) 

save(keep.promoters, file="rda/TEs_promoters.rda")
save(keep, file="rda/TEs_inpromoters_ingenes.rda")
```

## Separating Features (Genes from TEs)

**IMPORTANT: This step requires Seurat to be updated to version > 5.0**

```{r genes-tes, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/gencodeV48.rda")
load("rda/merge_scte.rda")

new <- ifelse(rownames(merge) %in% genes$Gene.Name, 
              paste0("Gene.", rownames(merge)), 
              paste0("TE.", rownames(merge)))

nrow(merge) 

merge[["RNA3"]] <- as(object = merge[["RNA"]], Class = "Assay")
merge[["RNA5"]] <- as(object = merge[["RNA3"]], Class = "Assay5")

merge <- Seurat.utils::RenameGenesSeurat(
  obj = merge,
  newnames = new,
  assay =  "RNA5",  
  slots = c("counts","data"))  

ncol(merge) 

DefaultAssay(merge) <- "RNA5"

genes.scte <- rownames(merge)[grepl("Gene.", rownames(merge))]
te.scte <- rownames(merge)[grepl("TE.", rownames(merge))]

seurat_genes <- subset(merge, features = genes.scte)
seurat_te <- subset(merge, features = te.scte)

nrow(seurat_genes) 
nrow(seurat_te) 

# Converting the name again
new <- gsub("^Gene\\.", "", rownames(seurat_genes))

seurat_genes <- Seurat.utils::RenameGenesSeurat(
  obj = seurat_genes,
  newnames = new,
  assay = "RNA5",  
  slots = c("counts","data"))

rm(new)

new <- gsub("^TE\\.", "", rownames(seurat_te))

seurat_te <- Seurat.utils::RenameGenesSeurat(
  obj = seurat_te,
  newnames = new,
  assay = "RNA5",  
  slots = c("counts","data"))

save(seurat_te, seurat_genes, file="rda/scTE_gencode.rda")
```

## Filtering Cells and Genes Based on the Cellranger Seurat Object

```{r filtering-cell, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# Seurat genes
seurat_genes@meta.data$cells <- rownames(seurat_genes@meta.data)
seurat_genes <- AddMetaData(seurat_genes, rownames(seurat_genes@meta.data), 
                            col.name = "cells")

common_cols <- intersect(colnames(seurat_genes), colnames(obj))
length(common_cols) 

seurat_genes <- seurat_genes[,colnames(seurat_genes) %in% common_cols] 
dim(seurat_genes) 

# Seurat TEs
seurat_te <- seurat_te[,colnames(seurat_te) %in% common_cols] 
dim(seurat_te)

# Adding metadata
seurat_te <- AddMetaData(seurat_te, rownames(seurat_te@meta.data),
                         col.name = "cells")

meta <- obj@meta.data[,c(5,13,18,23)]

seurat_genes <- AddMetaData(seurat_genes, meta)
seurat_te <- AddMetaData(seurat_te, meta)

# Filtering genes
features <- rownames(obj)

seurat_genes <- subset(seurat_genes, features = features)
```

## Normalize & Scale Seurat TEs

```{r norm-scale-scte, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
seurat_te <- JoinLayers(seurat_te, layers="RNA5")

seurat_te <- NormalizeData(
  object = seurat_te,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  scale.factor = 10000)

seurat_te <- ScaleData(seurat_te, features=rownames(seurat_te))
seurat_te <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat_te)
seurat_te <- RunPCA(seurat_te)
ElbowPlot(seurat_te,ndims = 50) 
seurat_te <- FindNeighbors(seurat_te, dims = 1:12)
seurat_te <- FindClusters(seurat_te, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "umap.inintegrated")
seurat_te <- RunUMAP(object = seurat_te, dims= 1:12, reduction = "pca", reduction.name = "umap.unintegrated")
DimPlot(seurat_te, reduction = "umap.unintegrated", label = T, label.box =TRUE) + NoLegend()

Idents(seurat_te) <- "umap.inintegrated"

seurat_te[["RNA5"]] <- split(seurat_te[["RNA5"]], f = seurat_te$Condition)

seurat_te <- IntegrateLayers(
  object = seurat_te, method = HarmonyIntegration,
  orig.reduction = "pca", new.reduction = "harmony"
)

seurat_te <- FindNeighbors(seurat_te, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:12)
seurat_te <- FindClusters(seurat_te, resolution = 1, cluster.name = "harmony_clusters")
seurat_te <- RunUMAP(seurat_te, reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:12, reduction.name = "umap.harmony")

DimPlot(seurat_te, reduction = "umap.harmony", group.by = "Condition")

save(seurat_genes, seurat_te, file="rda/seurats_scte.rda")
save(merge, file="rda/merge_scTE.rda")

rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

## Distribution of TEs in the scTE Seurat Object

```{r distribution-scte, warning=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/TEs.rda")
load("rda/seurats_scte.rda")
rm(seurat_genes)

table(TEs$TE.Class)

TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "LINE?", "TE.Class"] <- "LINE"
TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "SINE?", "TE.Class"] <- "SINE"
TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "DNA?", "TE.Class"] <- "DNA"
TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "LTR?", "TE.Class"] <- "LTR"
TEs[TEs$TE.Class == "RC?", "TE.Class"] <- "RC"

scTE_class <- data.frame(TE = rownames(seurat_te),
                         TE.Class = "Unknown")

match_indices <- match(scTE_class$TE, TEs$TE.Name)
a <- na.omit(match_indices)

scTE_class$TE.Class[!is.na(match_indices)] <- TEs$TE.Class[match_indices[!is.na(match_indices)]]
table(scTE_class$TE.Class)

see <- scTE_class[scTE_class$TE.Class == "Unknown",]

see[substr(see$TE, 1,2) == "RF", "TE.Class"] <- "LINE"
see[substr(see$TE, 1,3) == "AC0", "TE.Class"] <- "DNA"
see[substr(see$TE, 1,3) == "ABB", "TE.Class"] <- "DNA"
see[substr(see$TE, 1,3) == "ABH", "TE.Class"] <- "DNA"
see[substr(see$TE, 1,4) == "AARS", "TE.Class"] <- "DNA"
see[substr(see$TE, 1,3) == "AB0", "TE.Class"] <- "DNA"

table(see$TE.Class)

scTE_class[scTE_class$TE %in% see$TE, "TE.Class"] <- see$TE.Class[see$TE %in% scTE_class$TE]
table(scTE_class$TE.Class)

scTE_class[substr(scTE_class$TE, 1,5) == "Gene.", "TE.Class"] <- "Remove"
scTE_class <- scTE_class[!scTE_class$TE.Class == "Remove",]
scTE_class <- scTE_class[!duplicated(scTE_class$TE),]

save(scTE_class, file="rda/scTE_class.rda")

# Plotting 
data <- scTE_class %>%
  group_by(TE.Class) %>%
  summarize(Counts = n())

data$TE.Class <- factor(data$TE.Class, levels = c("DNA","LTR","LINE","SINE","Satellite",
                                                  "Simple_repeat","Unknown"))

data$Percentage <- data$Counts*100/21978

data$Percentage <- round(data$Percentage, 2)

data$Label <- paste0(data$Percentage, "%")

color <- brewer.pal(n=nrow(data),name = "Pastel1")

png("plots/Pie_TEs.png", width = 15, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
pie3D(
  x = data$Counts,
  labels = data$Label,
  explode = 0.05,
  col = color,
  labelcex = 0.75,
  main = "Percentage of each TE Class",
  theta = 1.2
)
legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c("DNA","LTR","LINE","SINE","Satellite",
             "Simple_repeat","Unknown"),
  fill = color,
  cex = 0.9
)
dev.off()

rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

# **PART 10 - Analyzing Exclusively HSCs**

```{r exclus-LTHSC, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/seurats_scte.rda")
rm(seurat_genes)
load("rda/scTE_class.rda")

colnames(seurat_te@meta.data)

hsc <- subset(seurat_te, subset = Type %in% c("HSC"))
dim(hsc) 

hsc <- subset(hsc, features = scTE_class$TE)
dim(hsc)

hsc <- JoinLayers(hsc)
save(hsc, file = "rda/seurat_te_HSC_tmp.rda")

# Heatmap
meta <- hsc@meta.data
matrix <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$scale.data)
raw <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$counts)
matrix <- matrix[,rownames(meta)]
raw <- raw[,rownames(meta)]
table(meta$Condition)
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition, levels = c("HD","FPD"))
condition <- factor(c(rep("HD",3095),
                      rep("FPD", 2030)))

all <- data.frame(TE=rownames(raw))

for (te in rownames(raw)) {
  
  a <- mean(raw[te,condition=="HD"])
  b <- mean(raw[te,condition=="FPD"])
  
  all[all$TE == te, "HD"] <- a
  all[all$TE == te, "FPD"] <- b
  
}

all2 <- pivot_longer(all, cols=-TE, names_to = c("Condition"), 
                     values_to = "Counts")

a <- all2[all2$Counts >= 0.5,]
b <- unique(a$TE) 

raw_mat <- raw[b,]
dim(raw_mat)
zscore <- function(x) {
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}
data <- as.data.frame(raw_mat)
zscore_data <- t(apply(data, 1, zscore))
dist_matrix <- dist(zscore_data)

a <- t(zscore_data)
hc <- hclust(dist(a), method = "ward.D2")
num_clusters <- 10
cluster_colors <- brewer.pal(num_clusters, "Dark2")

dend <- as.dendrogram(hc)
dend <- color_branches(dend, k = num_clusters, col = cluster_colors)
dend <- color_labels(dend, k = num_clusters, col = cluster_colors)

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Condition = meta$Condition,
  col = list(
    Condition = c(
      "HD" = "gray82", 
      "FPD" = "red3"
    )),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

rownames(scTE_class) <- scTE_class$TE

scTE_class <- scTE_class[rownames(zscore_data),]
order <- c("DNA","LTR","LINE","SINE","Satellite",
           "Simple_repeat","Unknown")
scTE_class$TE.Class <- factor(scTE_class$TE.Class, levels= order)
scTE_class <- scTE_class[order(scTE_class$TE.Class),]

zscore_data <- zscore_data[rownames(scTE_class),]

class <- scTE_class$TE.Class
class <- unique(class)
class <- factor(class, levels= c("DNA","LTR","LINE","SINE","Satellite",
                                 "Simple_repeat","Unknown"))
count_class <- length(class) 

getPalette <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(5, "Set1"))
class_colors <- getPalette(count_class)
show_col(class_colors)
list_cluster_colors <- setNames(class_colors, class)

h_class <- rowAnnotation(Class = scTE_class$TE.Class,
                         col = list(Class = list_cluster_colors),
                         show_annotation_name = FALSE)

names <- rowAnnotation(
  labels = anno_text(rownames(zscore_data), 
                     which = "row",
                     gp = gpar(fontsize = 1, lineheight = 8))) 

Heatmap(zscore_data, 
        name = "z-score per row",
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        column_title = NULL,
        show_row_names = FALSE, 
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        show_row_dend = FALSE,
        column_dend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
        top_annotation = ha,
        cluster_columns = dend, 
        show_column_dend = TRUE,
        right_annotation = names,
        left_annotation = h_class,
        border = TRUE)

# Labeling Groups
labels_list <- cutree(hc, k = 10)  
cluster_labels <- split(names(labels_list), labels_list)

for (i in 1:length(cluster_labels)) {
  cat("Cluster", i, ":\n")
  print(cluster_labels[[i]])
  cat("\n")
}

g10 <- as.data.frame(cutree(hc, k = 10))
colnames(g10) <- "Group"

merge.ht <- merge(g10,meta[,c("cells","Condition")],by.x=0, by.y="cells")
rownames(merge.ht) <- merge.ht$Row.names
merge.ht$Row.names <- NULL

merge.ht$Group <- paste0("Group_", merge.ht$Group)
merge.ht <- merge.ht[rownames(meta),]

ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Group = merge.ht$Group,
  Condition = merge.ht$Condition,
  col = list(
    Group = c(
      "Group_1" = "#E7298A",
      "Group_2" = "#7570B3",
      "Group_3" = "darkred",
      "Group_4" = "#666666",
      "Group_5" = "#D95F02",
      "Group_6" = "#1B9E77",
      "Group_7" = "#A6761D",
      "Group_8" = "cyan2",
      "Group_9" = "#E6AB02",
      "Group_10" ="#66A61E"),
    Condition = c(
      "HD" = "gray82", 
      "FPD" = "red3"
    )),
  annotation_name_side = "left",
  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

htm <- Heatmap(zscore_data, 
        name = "z-score per row",
        show_column_names = FALSE,
        column_title = NULL,
        show_row_names = FALSE, 
        cluster_rows = FALSE,
        show_row_dend = FALSE,
        column_dend_height = unit(4, "cm"),
        top_annotation = ha,
        cluster_columns = dend, 
        show_column_dend = TRUE,
        right_annotation = names,
        left_annotation = h_class,
        border = TRUE)

png("plots/Heatmap_TEs_HSCs.png",
    width = 16, height = 12, units = "in", res = 300)
grid.newpage()
draw(htm, newpage = FALSE)
dev.off()

merge.ht <- merge.ht[order(merge.ht$Group),]

save(merge.ht, file="rda/Groups_Heatmap_TEs_HSCs.rda")

# Rearranging Groups Based on Heatmap Visualization
merge.ht$Group_ed <- ""
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_2", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_1"
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_4", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_2"
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_6", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_2"
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_1", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_3"
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_8", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_3"
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_9", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_4"
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_10", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_4"
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_3", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_5"
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_5", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_5"
merge.ht[merge.ht$Group == "Group_7", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_5"

merge.ht$Group <- NULL
colnames(merge.ht)[2] <- "Group"

save(merge.ht, file="rda/Groups_Heatmap_Edited_TEs_HSCs.rda")

rm(list=ls())
gc()
```

```{r HSC-side, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
dev.off()
```

## TE Counts Level (Threshold)

Here, we consider only DNA Transposon, LTR, SINE and LINE since these categories represent the majority of TEs.

```{r TE-thr, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/scTE_class.rda")
load("rda/seurat_te_HSC_tmp.rda")

colors <- c("HD" = "gray82",
            "FPD" = "gray75")

sigFunc <- function(x) {
  if (x < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  } else if (x <= 0.01) {
    return("**")
  } else if (x <= 0.05) {
    return("*")
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

# LINE
line <- scTE_class$TE[scTE_class$TE.Class == "LINE"]
seurat <- subset(hsc, features = line)
meta <- seurat@meta.data
meta <- meta[order(meta$Condition),]
matrix <- as.matrix(seurat@assays$RNA5$scale.data)
raw <- as.matrix(seurat@assays$RNA5$counts)
matrix <- matrix[,rownames(meta)]
raw <- raw[,rownames(meta)]
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition, levels = c("HD","FPD"))
condition <- factor(c(rep("HD",2030),
                      rep("FPD", 3095)))

all <- data.frame(TE=rownames(raw))

for (te in rownames(raw)) {
  a <- mean(raw[te,condition=="HD"])
  b <- mean(raw[te,condition=="FPD"])
  all[all$TE == te, "HD"] <- a
  all[all$TE == te, "FPD"] <- b
}

all2 <- pivot_longer(all, cols=-TE, names_to = c("Condition"),
                     values_to = "Counts")
a <- all2[all2$Counts >= 1,]
b <- unique(a$TE) 
raw_mat <- raw[b,]

meta$Condition <- as.character(meta$Condition)
box <- as.data.frame(t(raw_mat))
box$sum <- rowSums(box)
box$Cond[rownames(box) %in% rownames(meta)] <- 
  meta$Condition[rownames(meta) %in% rownames(box)]
box$cells <- rownames(box)
box <- box[,c(113:115)]

df <- box %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(Cond, cells),  
    values_to = "counts")  

line <- ggplot(data = df, mapping = aes(x = Cond, y = counts)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Cond), position = position_dodge(width = 1.5),
               outlier.shape = 16, 
               outlier.size = 0.65, outlier.colour = "red3") +  
  geom_jitter(data = df %>% filter(counts %in% boxplot.stats(counts)$out),  
              aes(x = Cond, y = counts), 
              position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), 
              size = 1.5, 
              colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors, name = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 700, color = "gray85", linetype = "dashed", lwd=1) +
  stat_boxplot(aes(Cond, counts), geom = 'errorbar', linetype = 1,
               width = 0.3) + 
  stat_summary(aes(group = Cond), fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 1.5, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + 
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Total Counts") +
  geom_signif(test = "t.test", size = 0.25,
              comparisons = list(c("HD", "FPD")),
              map_signif_level = sigFunc,
              y_position = max(df$counts)) +
  scale_x_discrete(label = c("HD", 
                             "FPD")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color="black"), 
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 1, face = "bold", color="black", angle = 45),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white")
  )

ggsave("plots/LINE_Boxplot.png", line, height=5.4, width=7.2, dpi=300)
```

## Heatmap TEs

```{r save-heatmap, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/Boxplots_HSC_TE_cutoff.rda")
rm(dna.box, line.box, sine.box, ltr.box)
load("rda/seurat_te_HSC_tmp.rda")
load("rda/scTE_class.rda")
load("rda/Groups_Heatmap_Edited_TEs_HSCs.rda")
load("rda/seurats_harmony.rda")

hsc <- JoinLayers(hsc)
obj <- JoinLayers(obj)

crang <- obj@meta.data
metate <- hsc@meta.data
crang <- crang[rownames(metate),]
metate$Clusters <- NULL
metate <- merge(metate, crang[,c("cells","Clusters")], by.x="cells", by.y="cells")
rownames(metate) <- metate$cells

hsc <- AddMetaData(hsc, metate$Clusters, col.name = "Clusters_cr")
rm(metate,crang,obj)

merge.ht$cells <- rownames(merge.ht)
meta <- hsc@meta.data
meta <- meta[rownames(merge.ht),]
meta <- merge(meta, merge.ht[,c("Group","cells")], by.x="cells", by.y="cells")
rownames(meta) <- meta[,1]
meta <- meta[,-1]
meta$Group.x <- NULL
colnames(meta)[9] <- "Group"

colnames(plot)[4] <- "Level"
meta <- merge(x=meta, y=plot[,c("cells","Level","total")], by.x=0, by.y="cells")
rownames(meta) <- meta[,1]
meta <- meta[,-1]

meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition, levels=c("HD","FPD"))

meta$Group_ed <- ""
meta[meta$Group == "Group_1", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_1"
meta[meta$Group == "Group_2", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_2"
meta[meta$Group == "Group_4", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_3"
meta[meta$Group == "Group_3", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_4"
meta[meta$Group == "Group_5", "Group_ed"] <- "Group_5"

meta$Test <- ""
meta[meta$Group_ed == "Group_1", "Test"] <- "Group_1"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_2" & meta$Condition == "FPD" & meta$Level == "Low"), "Test"] <- "Group_2"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_2" & meta$Condition == "HD" & meta$Level == "Low"), "Test"] <- "Group_2"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_3" & meta$Level == "Low"), "Test"] <- "Group_2"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_4" & meta$Condition == "FPD" & meta$Level == "Low"), "Test"] <- "Group_2"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_4" & meta$Condition == "HD" & meta$Level == "Low"), "Test"] <- "Group_2"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_2" & meta$Level == "High"), "Test"] <- "Group_3"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_3" & meta$Level == "High"), "Test"] <- "Group_4"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_4" & meta$Level == "High"), "Test"] <- "Group_5"
meta[(meta$Group_ed == "Group_5" & meta$Level == "High"), "Test"] <- "Group_6"

table(meta$Test)

meta$Group <- NULL
meta$Group_ed <- NULL

colnames(meta)[11] <- "Group"

order <- c("Group_1","Group_2","Group_3","Group_4","Group_5","Group_6")
meta$Group <- factor(meta$Group, levels= order)

order2 <- c("Low","High")
meta$Level <- factor(meta$Level, levels= order2)

meta <- meta[order(meta$Group, meta$Condition, meta$Level),]
matrix <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$scale.data)
raw <- as.matrix(hsc@assays$RNA5$counts)
matrix <- matrix[,rownames(meta)]
raw <- raw[,rownames(meta)]

condition <- factor(c(rep("HD",2030), rep("FPD","3095")))

all <- data.frame(TE=rownames(raw))

for (te in rownames(raw)) {
  hd_values <- raw[te, condition == "HD"]
  fpd_values <- raw[te, condition == "FPD"]
  
  a <- mean(hd_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  b <- mean(fpd_values, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  all[all$TE == te, "HD"] <- a
  all[all$TE == te, "FPD"] <- b
}

all2 <- pivot_longer(all, cols=-TE, names_to = c("Condition"), 
                     values_to = "Counts")

a <- all2[all2$Counts >= 1,]
b <- unique(a$TE)

raw_mat <- raw[b,]
dim(raw_mat)

zscore <- function(x) {
  (x - mean(x)) / sd(x)
}

data <- as.data.frame(raw_mat)

zscore_data <- t(apply(data, 1, zscore))

rownames(scTE_class) <- scTE_class$TE

  show_legend = TRUE,
  show_annotation_name = FALSE
)

sum_level <- as.data.frame(t(raw_mat))
sum_level$sum_level <- rowSums(sum_level)
sum_level$cells <- rownames(sum_level)
sum_level <- sum_level[,c(393,394)]

meta$total <- NULL
meta <- merge(meta, sum_level, by.x=0, by.y="cells")
rownames(meta) <- meta$Row.names
meta$Row.names <- NULL

meta <- meta[rownames(sum_level),]

ha2 = HeatmapAnnotation(
  dist1 = anno_points(
    colSums(raw_mat), 
    col = ifelse(meta$Level[match(colnames(raw),
                                  rownames(meta))] == "Low", "lightblue", "blue2"),
    pch = 16, size = unit(0.55, "mm"), 
    bar_width = 1, 
    border = TRUE,
    height = unit(3.6, "cm")), 
  show_annotation_name = FALSE)

# Boxplot
sum <- as.data.frame(t(zscore_data))
sum$Total <- rowSums(sum)
sum$cells <- rownames(sum)
sum <- sum[,c(393,394)]
sum <- sum[rownames(meta),]
meta$cells <- rownames(meta)
sum <- merge(sum, meta, by.x="cells",by.y="cells")

cont = c(
  "Group_1" = "#386CB0",
  "Group_2" = "#8DB6CD",
  "Group_3" = "#FFF8DC",
  "Group_4" = "#FFDEAD",
  "Group_5" = "#FFC125",
  "Group_6" = "#D95F02")

color = "#EEE5DE"

# Anno point
anno <- ggplot(sum, aes(x = Group, y = Total, fill = Type, color = Group)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.65, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), 
               outlier.shape = 16, 
               outlier.size = 0.65, outlier.colour = "black",size= 0.2) +
  stat_boxplot(geom = 'errorbar', linetype = 1, width = 0.25, 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = color, name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cont, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-500, 800), breaks = seq(-500, 800, by = 200)) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"), 
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 1, r = 8, b = 1, l = -24)
  )

ha3 <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  ggplot = anno_empty(height = unit(7, "cm"))
)

ha <- c(ha3,ha2, ha1)

p <- Heatmap(zscore_data, 
              name = "z-score per row",
              show_column_names = FALSE,
              column_title = NULL,
              show_row_names = FALSE, 
              cluster_rows = FALSE,
              show_row_dend = FALSE,
              top_annotation = ha,
              cluster_columns = FALSE,  
              show_column_dend = FALSE,
              left_annotation = h_class,
              border = TRUE)

png("plots/Heatmap_TEs_HSCs_Final.png", width=16, height=12, units="in", res=300)
grid.newpage()
draw(p, newpage = FALSE)
decorate_annotation("ggplot", {
  vp = viewport(width = unit(1.02, "npc"), height = unit(1, "npc"))
  print(anno, vp = vp)
})
dev.off()

meta <- meta[colnames(hsc),]

hsc$Group <- NULL

save(zscore_data, file="rda/zscore_data_HSC_TEs.rda")
```

## Distribution of Cells per Group (Heatmap TEs)

```{r dist-groups, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/seurat_te_HSC.rda")

df <- hsc@meta.data %>%
  group_by(Group, Condition) %>%
  summarise(count = n())

count <- df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Condition, values_from = count)

count <- as.data.frame(count)
rownames(count) <- count[,1]
count$Group <- NULL

count$Total <- count$HD + count$FPD

count$PHG <- count$HD*100/count$Total
count$PHG <- round(count$PHG,1)
count$PFG <- count$FPD*100/count$Total
count$PFG <- round(count$PFG,1)

count$PH <- count$HD*100/2030
count$PH <- round(count$PH,1)
count$PF <- count$FPD*100/3095
count$PF <- round(count$PF,1)

count$PG <- count$Total*100/5125
count$PG <- round(count$PG,1)

sum_row <- colSums(count)
count <- rbind(count, sum_row)
rownames(count)[nrow(count)] <- "Total"

x <- count[,c(6,7)]
colnames(x) <- c("HD","FPD")
x$Group <- rownames(x)
x <- x[-7,]
x <- melt(x, id.vars = "Group")

order <- c("Group_1","Group_2","Group_3","Group_4","Group_5","Group_6")
x$Group <- factor(x$Group, levels = order)

x <- x[order(x$Group),]

order <- c("HD","FPD")
x$variable <- factor(x$variable, levels = order)

color = c(
  "Group_1" = "#386CB0",
  "Group_2" = "#8DB6CD",
  "Group_3" = "#FFF8DC",
  "Group_4" = "#FFDEAD",
  "Group_5" = "#FFC125",
  "Group_6" = "#D95F02")

p <- ggplot(x, aes(x = variable, y = value, fill = Group)) +
  geom_bar(width = 0.65, stat = "identity", position = "stack", 
           color = "black", size = 0.70) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = color, name=NULL) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "",
       y = "Percentage (%)") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(abs(x), "%")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12,
                                color = "black",
                                face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color="black"), 
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "white"),  
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "white"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    legend.position = "right",
  ) +
  coord_flip()

p

ggsave("plots/Histogram_NoCells_Norm_Groups_HSC.png", p, height=5.4, width=7.2, dpi=300)
write.csv(x, "csv/Boxplot_Heatmap_Groups_HSC.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

# **PART 12 - Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs)**

```{r degs, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/seurats_harmony.rda")
load("rda/seurat_te_HSC.rda")

hsc <- JoinLayers(hsc)
obj <- subset(obj, subset = cells %in% hsc@meta.data$cells)
dim(obj)

meta.obj <- obj@meta.data
meta <- hsc@meta.data

meta <- meta[match(colnames(obj), rownames(meta)), ]

obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$TE.Level, col = "Level")
obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$Group, col = "Group_Heat")

obj@meta.data$Condition <- as.character(obj@meta.data$Condition)
rm(meta,meta.obj)

meta <- obj@meta.data

meta$Contrast <- paste0(meta$Condition, "_", meta$Level)

obj <- AddMetaData(obj, meta$Contrast, col = "Contrast")

obj <- JoinLayers(obj)
obj <- NormalizeData(object = obj)
obj <- FindVariableFeatures(object = obj)
obj <- ScaleData(object = obj)

save(obj, file="rda/cellranger_HSC.rda")

mat_raw <- as.matrix(obj@assays$RNA$counts)

write.csv(mat_raw, "csv/Matrix_genes_raw_counts_HSC.csv", row.names = TRUE)

meta <- obj@meta.data

write.csv(meta, "csv/metadata_HSC.csv", row.names = TRUE)

ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes",
                     dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

rm(hsc, meta)
```

## HD High vs. HD Low

```{r hds, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}

Idents(obj) <- obj@meta.data$Contrast

df <- FindMarkers(obj, ident.1 = "HD_High", 
                  ident.2 = "HD_Low", assay = "RNA", test.use ="t")
df[1] <- NULL
df <- na.omit(df)
colnames(df) <- c("log2FC","HD_High","HD_Low", "pval.adj")
df$Status <- "ns"
df[(df$pval.adj <= 0.05 & df$log2FC > 0), "Status"] <- "Upregulated in HD_High"
df[(df$pval.adj <= 0.05 & df$log2FC < 0), "Status"] <- "Downregulated in HD_High"
df[df$pval.adj == 0, "Status"] <- "ns"
table(df$Status)

df$Status <- factor(df$Status, levels =c("Upregulated in HD_High", 
                                         "Downregulated in HD_High", 
                                         "ns"))

label <- df[(df$Status != "ns"), ]
label$Gene <- rownames(label)

a <- label[label$Status == "Downregulated in HD_High",]
a <- a %>%
  arrange(pval.adj) %>%  
  slice_head(n = 20)


b <- label[label$Status == "Upregulated in HD_High",]
b <- b %>%
  arrange(pval.adj) %>%  
  slice_head(n = 20)

c <- rbind(a,b)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(pval.adj), color = Status)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred","blue3","gray70"), name = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(1),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "", x = "log2(Fold Change)", y = "-log10(FDR)") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray97"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray97")) +
    geom_label_repel(data = c,
                   aes(label = Gene),
                   size = 2.1,
                   box.padding = 0.5,
                   force = 2,
                   nudge_y = 0.65,
                   max.overlaps = 100,
                   fontface ="bold",
                   show.legend = FALSE)

ggsave("plots/Volcano_DEGs.HSC_HD_High_Low.png", p, height=5.4, width=7.2, dpi=300)

write.csv(df, "csv/DEGs_HSC_HD_High_Low.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Biological Pathways
degs <- df[df$Status != "ns",]

## Up
up <- degs[degs$Status == "Upregulated in HD_High",]
genes <- rownames(up)

data = useDataset("hsapiens_gene_ensembl", mart=ensembl)
x <- listFilters(data)

go <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
               OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
               keyType = "SYMBOL", 
               ont = "BP")

up <- as.data.frame(go)

## Down
down <- degs[degs$Status == "Downregulated in HD_High",]
genes <- rownames(down)
go <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
               OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
               keyType = "SYMBOL", 
               ont = "BP")

down <- as.data.frame(go)

save(up, down, file="rda/HD_BP.rda")

rm(list=ls())
```

```{r fpd-hd, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
df$Status <- "ns"
df[(df$pval.adj <= 0.05 & df$log2FC > 0), "Status"] <- "Upregulated in FPD"
df[(df$pval.adj <= 0.05 & df$log2FC < 0), "Status"] <- "Downregulated in FPD"
df[df$pval.adj == 0, "Status"] <- "ns"
table(df$Status)

df$Status <- factor(df$Status, levels =c("Upregulated in FPD", 
                                         "Downregulated in FPD", 
                                         "ns"))

label <- df[(df$Status != "ns"), ]
label$Gene <- rownames(label)

a <- label[label$Status == "Upregulated in FPD",]
a <- a %>%
  arrange(pval.adj) %>%  
  slice_head(n = 60)

b <- label[label$Status == "Downregulated in FPD",]
b <- b %>%
  arrange(pval.adj) %>%  
  slice_head(n = 60)

c <- rbind(a,b)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(pval.adj), color = Status)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred","blue3","gray70"), name = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(1),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "", x = "log2(Fold Change)", y = "-log10(FDR)") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray97"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray97")) +
    geom_label_repel(data = c,
                   aes(label = Gene),
                   size = 2.1,
                   box.padding = 0.5,
                   force = 2,
                   nudge_y = 0.65,
                   max.overlaps = 100,
                   fontface ="bold",
                   show.legend = FALSE)

ggsave("plots/Volcano_DEGs.HSC_FPD_HD.png", p, height=5.4, width=7.2, dpi=300)

write.csv(df, "csv/DEGs_HSC_FPD_HD.csv", row.names = TRUE)

save(df, file="rda/all.deg.rda")

# Biological Pathways
degs <- df[df$Status != "ns",]

## Up
up <- degs[degs$Status == "Upregulated in FPD",]
genes <- rownames(up)
go <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
               OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
               keyType = "SYMBOL", 
               ont = "BP")

up <- as.data.frame(go)

## Down
down <- degs[degs$Status == "Downregulated in FPD",]
genes <- rownames(down)
go <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
               OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
               keyType = "SYMBOL", 
               ont = "BP")

down <- as.data.frame(go)

save(up, down, file="rda/all_BP.rda")

rm(list=ls())
```

## Organizing Biological Pathways

```{r org-bps, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
# HD
hd <- read.csv("csv/DEGs_HSC_HD_High_Low.csv", row.names=1)

hd <- hd %>%
  dplyr::filter(Status != "ns") %>%
  dplyr::select(1, 4, 5) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Genes")

# FPD
fpd <- read.csv("csv/DEGs_HSC_FPD_High_Low.csv", row.names=1)

fpd <- fpd %>%
  dplyr::filter(Status != "ns") %>%
  dplyr::select(1, 4, 5) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Genes")

# High
high <- read.csv("csv/DEGs_HSC_FPD_High_HD_High.csv", row.names=1)

high <- high %>%
  dplyr::filter(Status != "ns") %>%
  dplyr::select(1, 4, 5) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Genes")

# Low
low <- read.csv("csv/DEGs_HSC_FPD_Low_HD_Low.csv", row.names=1)

low <- low %>%
  dplyr::filter(Status != "ns") %>%
  dplyr::select(1, 4, 5) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Genes")

# Getting UNIQUE Features (Note that is no HD Low in these files)

## HD vs FPD
hd_unique <- anti_join(hd, fpd, by = "Genes")
fpd_unique <- anti_join(fpd, hd, by = "Genes")

## High vs Low
high_unique <- anti_join(high, low, by = "Genes")
low_unique <- anti_join(low, high, by = "Genes")

## HD vs High
a <- anti_join(hd, high, by = "Genes")
b <- anti_join(high, hd, by = "Genes")

## HD vs Low
c <- anti_join(hd, low, by = "Genes")
d <- anti_join(low, hd, by = "Genes")

## FPD vs High
e <- anti_join(fpd, high, by = "Genes")
f <- anti_join(high, fpd, by = "Genes")

## FPD vs Low
g <- anti_join(fpd, low, by = "Genes")
h <- anti_join(low, fpd, by = "Genes")

rm(hd,fpd,high,low)

## Only HD High
hd <- rbind(hd_unique, a,c)
hd <- hd[!duplicated(hd$Genes),]
hd_up <- hd[hd$Status == "Upregulated in HD_High",]
hd_down <- hd[hd$Status == "Downregulated in HD_High",]
rm(hd_unique,a,c, hd)

## Only FPD High
fpd <- rbind(fpd_unique, high_unique, b,e,f,g)
fpd <- fpd[!duplicated(fpd$Genes),]
fpd_up <- fpd[fpd$Status == "Upregulated in FPD_High",]
fpd_down <- fpd[fpd$Status == "Downregulated in FPD_High",]
rm(fpd,fpd_unique, high_unique, b,e,f,g)

## Only FPD Low
low <- rbind(low_unique, h,d)
low <- low[!duplicated(low$Genes),]
low_up <- low[low$Status == "Upregulated in FPD_Low",]
low_down <- low[low$Status == "Downregulated in FPD_Low",]
rm(low,low_unique, h,d)

# Saving
write.csv(hd_up, "csv/DEGs_HSC_unique_HD_High_Upregulated.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(hd_down, "csv/DEGs_HSC_unique_HD_High_Downregulated.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(fpd_up, "csv/DEGs_HSC_unique_FPD_High_Upregulated.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(fpd_down, "csv/DEGs_HSC_unique_FPD_High_Downregulated.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(low_up, "csv/DEGs_HSC_unique_FPD_Low_Upregulated.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(low_down, "csv/DEGs_HSC_unique_FPD_Low_Downregulated.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Plotting

## HD

### Up
genes <- hd_up$Genes
go <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
               OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
               keyType = "SYMBOL", 
               ont = "BP")

up <- as.data.frame(go)

up$ID <- NULL
up$ID <- make.names(up$Description)
rownames(up) <- up$ID

names(geneList) <- rownames(up)

                 readable = FALSE,
                 result = up,
                 pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                 qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                 organism = "human",
                 ontology = "UNKNOWN",
                 gene = unique(up$geneID),
                 keytype = "UNKNOWN",
                 universe = unique(up$geneID),
                 gene2Symbol = character(0),
                 geneSets = geneList)

a <- pairwise_termsim(enrichres)

p <- treeplot(a)

ggsave("plots/DEGs_BPs_HSC_unique_HD_High_Upregulated.png", p, height=8, width=9, dpi=300)
```

# **PART 14 - Comparing Group 1 (Low TE Expression) vs. Group 6 (High TE Expression)**

```{r group1vsgroup6, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE,eval=FALSE}
load("rda/seurat_te_HSC.rda")
groups <- subset(hsc, subset = Group %in% c("Group_1", "Group_6"))
rm(hsc)

load("rda/cellranger_HSC.rda")
hsc <- subset(obj, subset = cells %in% colnames(groups))

Idents(hsc) <- hsc@meta.data$Group

df <- FindMarkers(hsc, ident.1 = "Group_6", ident.2 = "Group_1", assay = "RNA", test.use = "t")

df[1] <- NULL
colnames(df) <- c("log2FC","Group_6","Group_1", "pval.adj")
df$Status <- "ns"
df[(df$pval.adj <= 0.05 & df$log2FC > 0), "Status"] <- "Upregulated in Group_6"
df[(df$pval.adj <= 0.05 & df$log2FC < 0), "Status"] <- "Upregulated in Group_1"
df[df$pval.adj == 0, "Status"] <- "ns"
table(df$Status)

df$Status <- factor(df$Status, levels =c("Upregulated in Group_6", 
                                         "Upregulated in Group_1", 
                                         "ns"))

label <- df[(df$Status != "ns"), ]
label$Gene <- rownames(label)

a <- label[label$Status == "Upregulated in Group_6",]
b <- label[label$Status == "Upregulated in Group_1",]

a <- a %>%
  arrange(pval.adj)  %>%  
  slice_head(n = 200)

a <- a %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FC))  %>%  
  slice_head(n = 25)

b <- b %>%
  arrange(pval.adj)  %>%  
  slice_head(n = 200)

b <- b %>%
  arrange(desc(log2FC))  %>%  
  slice_head(n = 25)

c <- rbind(a,b)

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(pval.adj), color = Status)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred","blue3","gray70"), name = NULL) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = log2(1),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(title = "", x = "log2(Fold Change)", y = "-log10(FDR)") +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray97"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray97")) +
    geom_label_repel(data = c,
                   aes(label = Gene),
                   size = 1.8,
                   box.padding = 0.5,
                   force = 2,
                   nudge_y = 0.65,
                   max.overlaps = 100,
                   fontface ="bold",
                   show.legend = FALSE)

ggsave("plots/Volcano_DEGs.HSC_Group6_Group_1.png", p, height=5.4, width=7.2, dpi=300)

write.csv(df, "csv/DEGs_HSC_Group6_Group_1.csv", row.names = TRUE)

# Biological Pathways
degs <- df[df$Status != "ns",]

## Up Group_6
up <- degs[degs$Status == "Upregulated in Group_6",]
genes <- rownames(up)
go <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
               OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
               keyType = "SYMBOL", 
               ont = "BP")

up <- as.data.frame(go)
up$ID <- NULL
up$ID <- make.names(up$Description)
rownames(up) <- up$ID

names(geneList) <- rownames(up)

                 readable = FALSE,
                 result = up,
                 pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                 qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                 organism = "human",
                 ontology = "UNKNOWN",
                 gene = unique(up$geneID),
                 keytype = "UNKNOWN",
                 universe = unique(up$geneID),
                 gene2Symbol = character(0),
                 geneSets = geneList)

a <- pairwise_termsim(enrichres)

p <- treeplot(a)

## Up Group_1

go <- enrichGO(gene = genes,
               OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", 
               keyType = "SYMBOL", 
               ont = "BP")

down <- as.data.frame(go)
down$ID <- NULL
down$ID <- make.names(down$Description)
rownames(down) <- down$ID

geneList <- strsplit(down$geneID, "/")
names(geneList) <- rownames(down)

enrichres <- new("enrichResult",
                 readable = FALSE,
                 result = down,
                 pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                 qvalueCutoff = 0.2,
                 organism = "human",
                 ontology = "UNKNOWN",
                 gene = unique(down$geneID),
                 keytype = "UNKNOWN",
                 universe = unique(down$geneID),
                 gene2Symbol = character(0),
                 geneSets = geneList)

a <- pairwise_termsim(enrichres)

p <- treeplot(a)

ggsave("plots/DEGs_BPs_HSC_Group_1_Upregulated.png", p, height=8, width=9, dpi=300)

df <- a@result

write.csv(df, "csv/DEGs_BPs_HSC_Group_1_Upregulated.csv", row.names = TRUE)

rm(list=ls())
```

```{r reactive, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
  "APOBEC3B","AICDA","TOP1","TOP2A","TOP2B","SMOX","PAOX","OGG1","MUTYH","NTHL1","NEIL1","NEIL2","NEIL3",
  "UNG","APEX1","POLB","XRCC1","PARP1","PARP2","ATM","ATR","CHEK1","CHEK2","TP53","CDKN1A","CGAS","STING1",
  "TBK1","IRF1","IRF3","IRF7","IRF9","IFNAR1","IFNAR2","JAK1","TYK2","STAT1","STAT2","ISG15","IFIT1","CXCL10",
  "TLR2","TLR4","MYD88","TRAF6","NFKB1","NFKBIA","RELA","TNF","IL1B","IL6","RNASEH1","RNASEH2A","RNASEH2B",
  "RNASEH2C","SETX","RPA1","RPA2","RB1","E2F1","E2F2","CCNE1","MCM2","MCM3","MCM4","MCM5","MCM6","MCM7","PCNA",
  "NFE2L2","KEAP1","MRC1","IL10","TGFB1","MERTK","AXL","GAS6","CD163","MARCO","PRF1","GZMB","GZMA","GNLY","NKG7",
  "IFNG","FASLG","TNFSF10","CTSW"))

  "OGG1","MUTYH","NTHL1","NEIL1","NEIL2","NEIL3","UNG","SMUG1","TDG","MBD4","APEX1","POLB","XRCC1","LIG3",
  "PARP1","PARP2","PARG","APTX","TDP1","BRCA1","BRCA2","PALB2","RAD51","RAD52","RAD54L","BARD1","FANCD2",
  "FANCI","BRIP1","XRCC5","XRCC6","PRKDC","LIG4","XRCC4","NHEJ1","TP53BP1","DCLRE1C","MSH2","MSH3","MSH6",
  "MLH1","PMS2","PMS1","EXO1","XPA","XPC","ERCC1","ERCC2","ERCC3","ERCC4","ERCC5","DDB1","DDB2","FANCA",
  "FANCB","FANCC","FANCE","FANCF","FANCG","FANCL","ATM","ATR","CHEK1","CHEK2","TP53","CDKN1A","MDM2","H2AFX",
  "RPA1","RPA2","RPA3","CLSPN","TOPBP1","CDC45","MCM2","MCM7","APOBEC3A","APOBEC3B","AICDA","REV1","POLH",
  "TERT","TERF1","TERF2","POT1","TINF2","ACD","RTEL1","POLG","TFAM","TWNK","SSBP1","MGME1"))

Idents(obj) <- obj@meta.data$Condition

# DEGs per Cell Type
types <- unique(obj@meta.data$Type)

for (type in types) {
  
  cat("Processing:", type, "\n")
  
  # subset object by cell type
  sub_obj <- subset(obj, subset = Type == type)
  
  # set identity to condition (HD vs FPD)
  Idents(sub_obj) <- sub_obj@meta.data$Condition
  
  # skip if not both groups present
  if (!all(c("HD","FPD") %in% unique(Idents(sub_obj)))) {
    cat("Skipping (missing condition):", type, "\n")
    next
  }
  
  # run DEG
  df <- FindMarkers(sub_obj, ident.1 = "HD", ident.2 = "FPD",
                    assay = "RNA", test.use = "t")
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0) next
  
  df <- na.omit(df)
  
  # clean + rename
  colnames(df) <- c("pval","log2FC","pct_HD","pct_FPD","pval.adj")
  df$Gene <- rownames(df)
  
  # classification
  df$Status <- "ns"
  df[df$pval.adj <= 0.05 & df$log2FC > 0, "Status"] <- "Up in HD"
  df[df$pval.adj <= 0.05 & df$log2FC < 0, "Status"] <- "Up in FPD"
  
  df$Status <- factor(df$Status, levels = c("Up in HD","Up in FPD","ns"))
  
  # select top genes for labeling
  label <- df[df$Status != "ns", ]
  
  top_up <- label %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Status == "Up in HD") %>% 
    arrange(pval.adj) %>% 
    slice_head(n = 20)
  
  top_down <- label %>% 
    dplyr::filter(Status == "Up in FPD") %>% 
    arrange(pval.adj) %>% 
    slice_head(n = 20)
  
  lab_genes <- rbind(top_up, top_down)
  
  # volcano plot
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(pval.adj), color = Status)) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("darkred","blue","gray70")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(title = paste0("Volcano: ", type),
         x = "log2(Fold Change)",
         y = "-log10(FDR)") +
    geom_label_repel(data = lab_genes,
                     aes(label = Gene),
                     size = 3,
                     max.overlaps = 100,
                     show.legend = FALSE)
  
  # save outputs
  ggsave(paste0("plots/Volcano_", gsub(" ", "_", type), ".png"),
         p, height = 6, width = 9, dpi = 300)
  
  write.csv(df,
            paste0("csv/DEG_", gsub(" ", "_", type), ".csv"),
            row.names = FALSE)
}
```
